subject: Software Carpentry Bootcamp for scientific computing skills, June 16-17th

messages.author: 8c8f0ca54c4a2459
messages.subject: Software Carpentry Bootcamp for scientific computing skills, June 16-17th
parts:
Dear all,

On June 16-17th, the library and the postdoc union are hosting a Software Carpentry Bootcamp. Software Carpentry’s aim is to teach researchers basic computing concepts and skills so that they can get more done in less time, and with less pain. The curriculum will be:

  • Introduction to Unix shell
  • Version control & an introduction to databases and SQL
  • Introduction to programming with R
  • Testing your code and creating reproducible analyses

I HIGHLY recommend their curriculum even if you have some R experience, as it teaches you not just to do statistical analyses in R but the tools to manage data and make those analyses automated and reproducible.

There is a registration fee of $37.92. D-RUG can support up to 8 of our members attending. The first 8 D-RUG listserv members to send me their registration confirmations will be reimbursed after the workshop.

Space is limited, so register ASAP! More details at the registration link below:

http://ucdavis-swc.eventbrite.com

Questions? See the FAQ, or contact the organizers: Jonathan Cachat (jca...@ucdavis.edu; @jcachat) and Benjamin Schwessinger (bschwe...@ucdavis.edu; @schwessinger).

Thanks to UC Library and the Union for Postdocs for organizing this bootcamp.

Best,

Noam
